approach: Agents of a study job get a tree without the other systems' studies; the gate does not. Add `Snapshot::create_hiding(..., hidden: &[String])` in athena-git; the existing `create` and public `materialize` keep their signatures and mean "full tree". The hidden directories are dropped when the snapshot is materialized (base, candidate and seed trees alike), so they are absent from both sides of the snapshot's diff. `change_list()` also drops stray paths under them, and `hidden_writes()` reports those drops. A new `Athena::hidden_study_dirs(ctx)` in run/pin.rs reads the repository URL of the job's recorded pin (`ctx.job.job.pin`, set at run/mod.rs:1239/1272, so it does not depend on how the schema selects the system). It returns every `studies/<d>` at the base commit whose pin.json `repository_url` (normalised: no trailing `.git` or `/`) differs or is unreadable. A change job has no pin, so it hides nothing. The producer snapshot and the verifier AGENT snapshot use it. Athena's gate stays on the full tree: the checks, demonstration reverts and baseline run in the unhidden verifier/baseline snapshots, so the repository's own tests that read studies/firstmate-work-handling (drain.rs:5017, drain.rs:6948, xtask site_page.rs:11) pass there. Right after the checks and demonstrations, `verification_stage` swaps in a hiding snapshot of the same base and candidate for the verifier agent and its two reruns. The reader hides other studies when the request selects exactly one study system, using the same selector `pin_repo` uses (reused, not rewritten). Last, add the hermes-agent table to athena.toml. Step 1 stops the producer if the base lacks the systems schema or a request-text selector.

decisions.choice: Keep the gate on the full tree and hide only from the agents. Checks (mod.rs:1937 via `verifier_snapshot`), demonstration reverts (checks.rs:663) and baseline checks (checks.rs:955) keep calling the unhidden functions. `verification_stage` rebuilds the verifier's snapshot with `verifier_snapshot_hiding` just before the disk check at verification.rs:157, so the verifier agent and both reruns (:313, :341) see the hidden view.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 4 (blocker). The study capability's check `cargo test --locked` (athena.toml:122-125) runs in the verifier snapshot (mod.rs:1936-1943), and drain.rs:5017 (`include_str!` of studies/firstmate-work-handling/model.json), drain.rs:6948 (`read_dir`) and xtask/tests/site_page.rs:11 would fail or not compile if studies/firstmate-work-handling were hidden there. A Hermes job would always fail its checks. CI already runs on the pushed candidate, which is the full tree. Candidate and checks are unchanged by hiding, so what is verified is what lands. The swap happens after checks and demonstrations, so no check sees the hidden view. `prepared` becomes the hidden snapshot's tree, so the existing change detection and reruns compare like with like.

rejected.option: Move the fixtures out of studies/ (option b)
rejected.why: It touches athena-cli tests and the xtask site generator (STUDY_DIR in site.rs:17), and the request puts the site out of scope. It also would not fix the producer's other uses of the studies.

rejected.option: Hide in the checks snapshot too
rejected.why: Every Hermes job fails its own test check on the unchanged repository tests.

decisions.choice: Leave `Snapshot::create` and public `materialize` as they are and add `create_hiding` and an internal `materialize_hiding`. Only the reader, the producer snapshot and the verifier-agent snapshot call the hiding form.
decisions.reason: Answers findings 1 and 2: with an unchanged `create`, run/mod.rs, run/checks.rs, run/planning.rs and steward.rs need no edit. Planning and the steward read the full tree on purpose, and a study is never planned (run_pin_tests.rs:325). Hiding applies only where an agent works inside a study job.

rejected.option: Make the hidden list a required parameter of `create`
rejected.why: It forces one-line edits in mod.rs, checks.rs, planning.rs and steward.rs, all of which must pass an empty list, and none of those callers hands the tree to a study agent.

decisions.choice: Choose the directories to hide by the URL of the job's recorded pin: keep `studies/<d>` whose pin.json `repository_url` equals the pin's `url` after stripping a trailing `/` and `.git`; hide every other directory, including one whose pin.json is missing or not valid JSON. The helper reads `ctx.job.job.pin`; no new RunContext field. `study_pin`'s exact-match rule stays as it is.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 8: the normalised comparison cannot hide a system's own study because of a `.git` mismatch. The error runs toward showing the job's own system's studies, so a study_pin mismatch only over-shares. The directory name is not the system id (`firstmate-work-handling` vs `firstmate`). Using the recorded pin does not depend on the schema's selector, which this base does not show. Failing closed on an unreadable pin follows S1.

rejected.option: Match the directory name to the system id
rejected.why: firstmate's own study would be hidden from its own job.
It needs a second mapping from system id to config; the URL is already the join key `study_pin` uses.

decisions.choice: The selector for the reader is the one `pin_repo` uses to pick a system from the request, extracted into a shared helper `study_system_url(config, request) -> Option<String>` in pin.rs if it is not already callable. The reader hides the other studies when it returns a URL and nothing otherwise (no system, several, or an error). Step 1 reads the base's selector first and stops if there is none or if it needs something the reader does not have.
decisions.reason: Answers findings 6 and 7: the plan no longer invents a whole-word selector. If the schema supplies one, the reader's notion of 'system b' is exactly what the job later pins. If the base has none the producer stops and reports. The trade-off remains and is stated: the reader runs before the capability is known (read_once at reading.rs:551), so a CHANGE request that names a configured system id also gets a reader view without the other studies. Its producer and verifier still see all studies, since they follow the pin. The change-job test asserts this on a request that names a configured system and records all three roles.

rejected.option: Hide all studies from every reader
rejected.why: A change request such as 'fix studies/firstmate-work-handling/claims.json' needs to see them.
Criterion 2 requires the reader's snapshot to omit the other studies.

decisions.choice: `change_list()` drops entries at or under a hidden directory. The new `Snapshot::hidden_writes()` returns those dropped paths, and the producer loop (producer.rs after :413) prints one `hidden` line naming them. The record of the change gets nothing new.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 9. Hidden directories are absent from the base commit and the work tree, so the diff never shows them as deleted. A stray write is not landed, and the owner sees the attempt in the run output. `build_candidate` applies only the change entries to the full base tree (candidate.rs:34), so the hidden directories keep their base blobs and land byte-identical.

rejected.option: Refuse a job that writes under a hidden directory
rejected.why: A new study whose name collides would stop an otherwise good run. The request asks for unchanged landing, not a refusal.
The attempt leaves no trace anywhere.

decisions.choice: Keep the study producer's own cargo runs as they are. Tests that read other studies (drain.rs:5017 fails to compile under clippy/check --all-targets; drain.rs:6948 and site_page.rs:11 panic) fail in its snapshot. The authoritative result is Athena's gate and CI on the full tree.
decisions.reason: Moving those fixtures is out of scope (site, firstmate study) and the request fixes the isolation. A study producer writes data files under studies/<id>/; its fmt (the format stage, producer.rs:172) and `cargo build` still work. The remaining limitation is stated in risks and put to the user.

rejected.option: Skip those tests when the directory is missing
rejected.why: `include_str!` cannot be skipped, and a silent skip would hide real breakage.

decisions.choice: Commit-shape outcomes. Job commit on visible paths: lands as before. Job commit that also writes a hidden path: that entry is dropped and the rest lands. Records-only commit: `records/` is already absent, unchanged. Owner-path (athena-exclude) commit: `classify` still hides it, unchanged. Intervention commit already on the base touching studies/<other>: it is in the base tree; hidden from a study job's three agent snapshots, visible to change jobs and to the gate. Retry-after-block landing (BaseThenTree) and a kept-dir resume (BaseThenDir): the seed tree is materialized with the same list, so the change list is still against the hidden base.
decisions.reason: No landing, history-check or attribution classification function changes: only the agents' snapshot contents and the snapshot's own change list. Callers of `change_list`: candidate.rs:34, run/mod.rs:948 and :2254, producer.rs:205, :217, :413. They get the same result for an empty list.

rejected.option: Teach landing or the history check about hidden paths
rejected.why: Hidden paths never enter the snapshot repository.

Add internal `materialize_hiding` (public `materialize` delegates with `&[]`) that removes every index entry equal to a hidden entry or under `<entry>/`, in the same removals list as `records/` and excluded paths. Refuse an empty, absolute or `..` entry with `GitError::Refused`. Store the list on `Snapshot`; `change_list()` drops hidden paths; add `hidden_writes()`; BaseAndCandidate and BaseThenTree re-materialize with the same list. Extract the system selector `pin_repo` uses into a shared helper only if it is not already callable by the reader.
`producer_snapshot` calls `create_hiding` with `hidden_study_dirs(ctx)`; the producer loop prints a `hidden` line from `snapshot.hidden_writes()` after the change list at :413.

In `read_once` (:551) compute the hidden list from the shared selector and `other_study_dirs` over `jc.commit`, and call `create_hiding`. Add unit tests for the request forms.

Fix the `config` helper (:80-107) to drop systems tables; add an unstripped-config helper; give the fake study capability a `check` field and `athena_with` a `capability` parameter; add a recording UI and the tests for criteria 1, 2 and 3 (hermes, hidden_studies, hidden_directory).
Fix `repo_with_config` (:295-310) to drop `[capabilities.study.systems.*]` tables. No other edit.
Not in the reading's list. Forced test helper edit (:1049-1060): drop the systems tables, as in the other two helpers, so the new table is not left without its keys.

Add `[capabilities.study.systems.hermes-agent]` with repo_url "https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git" and repo_ref = "v2026.9.24", with a comment naming the annotated tag and release v0.21.5. Firstmate's lines 105-106 stay untouched. Governance file: allowed because the reading lists it.

Record that the separation promised at lines 94-95 and 218 is now enforced in code: which snapshots hide which directories, that the gate stays on the full tree, and that a study is tied to a system by its pin.json URL.

Run `cargo fmt --all`, then `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`. Also run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus`, and fix anything failing.

risks.risk: The base lacks the systems schema, so criterion 1 and the athena.toml entry cannot hold.
risks.mitigation: Step 1 stops the producer unconditionally if the schema or the request-text selector is absent, and lands nothing. The plan does not invent either.

risks.risk: The verifier agent's rebuilt snapshot differs from the one the checks ran in, so it could judge a different tree.
risks.mitigation: Both are built from the same base and candidate commits; only the hidden directories differ, and the change list never includes them. The rebuild's tree becomes `prepared`, which the existing snapshot-unchanged check and both reruns compare against. The criterion-3 test lands a job through this path.

risks.risk: A study directory with no readable pin.json is hidden from every study job, including its own system's.
risks.mitigation: The study rules require a pin.json per study. A test commits a study without a pin.json and asserts it is hidden, so the fail-closed rule is fixed.

risks.risk: A study producer's own cargo clippy --all-targets or cargo test fails in its snapshot on tests that read the hidden firstmate study.
risks.mitigation: The gate and CI use the full tree and decide the result. The producer's formatter and cargo build still work. The limitation is in the dependents list and put to the user as an open question.

risks.risk: The reader hides other studies for a change request that names a study system.
risks.mitigation: The match is the same selector the job's pin uses. It applies only when exactly one system is selected. The change-job test fixes the behaviour, and the open question asks the user to accept it.

risks.risk: A planner or critic of a study job would see all studies.
risks.mitigation: A study is never planned (run_pin_tests.rs:325, 'a study is not planned even with job planning enabled'), so there is no such snapshot today.

risks.risk: Earlier job records and the evidence snapshot may still describe another system's study.
risks.mitigation: Out of scope: the request limits the change to studies/<id>/ in agent snapshots.
